line: ASUS Zenbook 14 OLED (2026, UX3480KA, AMD Krackan Point)
config_name: Zenbook 14 OLED — Ryzen AI 7 445, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB SSD, 14" 2K 60Hz glossy OLED

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 7 445 (Krackan Point, 8-core: 2 Zen5 + 6 Zen5c)
specs.keyboard_notes: White backlit, 1.7mm travel, oversized glass touchpad

battery.notes: 70Wh. Ultrabookreview: ~12-14h text editing, 15h+ video (Whisper mode, 120 nits). Some base SKUs ship 50Wh — check before buying.

price.notes: BBY direct SKU 19826848, reg=sale $1,999.99 (2026-11-24). UBR EU price 1299 EUR.

offers.name: ASUS Zenbook 14 14" OLED Laptop - AMD Ryzen AI 7 445 - 16GB LPDDR5X - 512GB SSD - Windows 11 Home - Jade Black

reviews.quote: What you're getting here is a versatile platform for daily use and multitasking, arguably a little faster with mixed use than the similar-level Intel option, while still running efficiently, quietly, and coolly.
dim 2K OLED display, with PWM flickering at all brightness levels; no other panel option available

praises: 70Wh battery genuinely delivers all-day runtimes — quiet even under multi-tab loads
Good port mix for a thin 14-inch: USB-C 4.0 + USB-A + HDMI without a dongle
Light 1.2 kg chassis with cleaner design than the old UX3405
OLED colours pop for media despite the low brightness
Runs cool and near-silent in Whisper mode (UBR measured sub-35 dBA)
complaints: 2K OLED is dim (~300 nits) with visible PWM flicker at all brightness levels — dealbreaker for light-sensitive users
Screen only opens ~150 degrees now, a step back from 180-degree predecessors
Oversized touchpad prone to ghost touches (UBR + user reports)
Only 16GB soldered RAM on this tier; no 32GB option with the AMD panel combo
60Hz panel feels slow next to 120Hz rivals at this price

design_philosophy: ASUS's volume mid-range OLED ultrabook: premium look at mainstream price, OLED + big battery in a compact chassis. The 2026 UX3480 refresh refines aesthetics and build but drops panel brightness and hinge angle; the AMD variant trades spec headroom for a lower price than the Panther Lake Intel model.
rating_notes: Anchored on Ultrabookreview's UX3480KA review (Ryzen AI 7 345 config, 4/5); this 445 config is a modest uplift (+0.5 productivity/gaming). Ratings inferred from that sibling config: dim 300-nit PWM OLED caps readability_bright at 5 and screen_quality at 7. BBY customer rating 4.33/5 (12 reviews).
